# EuroTrex

EuroTrex is a mobile trail companion and route planner for European long-distance trails, beginning with the E4 in Cyprus. It is designed to make multi-stage hiking more approachable for beginners and experienced walkers.

Core app features include offline route guidance, flexible start and finish selection, day-by-day stage planning, elevation context and practical accommodation near the trail. EuroTrex is preparing official iOS and Android releases.

The Cyprus E4 is the first EuroTrex route. The longer-term aim is to extend the same clear trail-planning and host-network model to Greece and other European E-paths.

Hikers use the mobile app and do not create website accounts. Accommodation owners can use the partner portal to submit a property, follow its review and maintain approved information. EuroTrex verifies listings and material updates before publishing them in the app.
